label: late original-phase steps in sequences starting with i/f/p/o (diffuse prefix code)
explanation: Very sparse (0.026% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at t>=3 (91% of mass), peaking at the last original token and the <DEL> step, never at t<3 and almost never past recall_idx 1. Enriched for sequences whose first token is i/f/p/o (esp. i, 12x lift), second token i/0, third token a/b, and current inputs like v/1/p/3/s. These look like a conjunctive code over the sequence prefix plus current token; no simple predicate reaches useful precision (best F1 ~0.04; the first-token predicate covers ~74% of mass at 0.5% precision). Magnitude grows modestly toward the end of the original phase. Does not fire at t<3 or during most of the copy phase.
